title: C-VARC: A Large-Scale Chinese Value Rule Corpus for Value Alignment of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on creating a large-scale corpus of value rules (C-VARC) based on a hierarchical framework of Chinese values. This corpus is specifically designed for evaluating the moral and ethical alignment of Large Language Models, including the generation and analysis of 'moral dilemma scenarios'. The entire methodology and contribution revolve around benchmarking ethical and value-based judgments, which is a core component of the research.
